subject: Scheduling follow-up: LumenHealth demo — timezone coordination
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: LumenHealth product demo — multiple zone options

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’d love to run a 45-minute demo next week focused on model serving performance and how Redwood handles cross-region fallbacks. I pulled a few options below and tried to list local times for your team and ours — please let me know what works best or suggest an alternate window.

Proposed slots (CEST / EDT / PDT):
- Wed Apr 8 — 10:00 CEST / 04:00 EDT / 01:00 PDT (likely too early for us in SF)
- Wed Apr 8 — 16:00 CEST / 10:00 EDT / 07:00 PDT
- Thu Apr 9 — 09:30 CEST / 03:30 EDT / 00:30 PDT

Agenda (attached):
- 10m: intros + goals
- 20m: live demo (hosted + dedicated routing)
- 10m: Q&A + procurement next steps

Attached: lumen-demo-agenda-v1.pdf; Redwood quicksheet.

I noticed you mentioned some teams in APAC might join — if that’s the case we can prioritize the 16:00 CEST slot to be more APAC-friendly (it lines up late evening there).

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, LumenHealth Procurement <ctech-procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Scheduling: LumenHealth product demo — multiple zone options

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the options. Quick note — Apr 8–9 is our regional DST cutover window and a few folks will be out; the 10:00 CEST suggestion is actually 05:00 UK time due to the changeover and will not work for our London and Barcelona teams.

The 16:00 CEST slot looks promising for EMEA, but for our US procurement and engineering leads 10:00 EDT would be ideal. To avoid the DST handoff confusion, could we either:

- Move to Tue Apr 14 at 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT (clean week after cutover), or
- Keep Wed Apr 8 but shift to 14:00 CEST / 08:00 EDT so it’s clearly outside the DST switchover window for both regions.

Also looping in procurement (ctech-procurement@lumenhealth.com) — they’ll need the demo recording and a short SLA overview before legal signs an NDA.

Thanks —
Amanda Torres
Head of Clinical Integrations | LumenHealth
amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:25:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Scheduling: LumenHealth product demo — multiple zone options

Amanda — thanks for the flag. That was my bad — I converted the slots using a tool that didn’t account for the EU DST shift on the 8th.

14 Apr at 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT works for us. If that’s the consensus I’ll ask Kim to send an invite and include the recording/SLAs for procurement.

Markus
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <ctech-procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 12:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Scheduling: LumenHealth product demo — multiple zone options

Markus —

14 Apr at 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT is perfect. A couple quick asks from procurement before the session:
- Can you attach a one-page SLA summary (uptime, data residency, support hours)?
- Please record the session and share the recording link within 24 hours.
- Whoever sends the invite, please mark timezone explicitly (e.g., “15:00 CEST (UTC+2) / 09:00 EDT (UTC-4)”) so our calendar system doesn’t re-interpret it.

Procurement also prefers if the calendar invite includes: DocuSign NDA link (if needed), and either a GMeet link or Redwood-hosted meeting URL.

Thanks and see you on the 14th —
Amanda

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda.torres@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, LumenHealth Procurement <ctech-procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 14:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Scheduling: LumenHealth product demo — multiple zone options

Amanda / team —

Thanks for the quick coordination — the demo is confirmed:
- When: Wed 14 Apr 2026, 15:00 CEST (UTC+2) / 09:00 EDT (UTC-4)
- Duration: 45 minutes
- Meeting link: https://redwood.app/meet/kimberly-lumen-042 (preferred)
- Recording: we will record and share within 12 hours

Attached to this invite: lumen-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda) and redwood-demo-quicksheet.pptx (SLA summary included as slide 2). I’ll also add a one-page SLA summary as a PDF to the recording email.

DocuSign NDA: if procurement wants one before the demo, here’s a placeholder link — https://docusign.com/s/placeholder-nda — please confirm and we’ll send the formal DocuSign envelope.

Invite uses explicit timezone labels as requested. If anything changes for your APAC attendees, flag here and we’ll add an asynchronous recording option.

Looking forward to it —
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
